_comment: Diversity temperature of one variant of a sequential multi-prediction, replayed through _shared/lua/llm/temperature.lua by the macOS (modules/llm/api_common.lua) and Linux (modules/llm/inference.lua) runners. The policy is a fixture with the shape of the diversity_temperature section of _shared/modules/llm/inference.json, chosen apart from the shipped tuning so a tuning change never edits these vectors. The step is step_when_base_le_0_15 for a base at or below 0.15, step_when_base_le_0_35 at or below 0.35 and step_default above, unless a vector gives one; from the second variant a base below effective_base_floor is raised to it; the result is clamped at max_temperature. An omitted step means the base chooses it. Compare with a tolerance of 1e-9. The AutoHotkey twin (LLM_ApiCommon_GetDiversityTemp) does not replay this file yet, and reads an explicit step of 0 as no step, which is why no vector passes 0.
